sections.text: Introduction

 transmission lines and under ground cables. Test set equipment type ZFB
 contained three portable metal cases: Supply unit, Control unit, Fault
 impedance.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet .
Ensure that Line isolation is done.

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted and VT secondary circuits are opened before 
 injection.

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Static distance protection relays for the protection of high voltage
 transmission lines and under ground cables. Test set equipment type ZFB
 contained three portable metal cases: Supply unit, Control unit, Fault
 impedance.
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet .
Ensure that Line isolation is done.
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted and VT secondary circuits are opened before 
 injection.
A work 
 permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet .
Ensure that Line isolation is done.
Work to be carried out
Preliminary Steps to Prepare for Relay Testing
Use station 
 drawing to isolate
Testing the Relay and Protection Outputs
Preparation
Testing the Phase to Phase Measuring Elements
Calculate from line impedance Z, the value for phase to phase impedance
 corresponding to zone one setting.
Note:The corresponding X (choke tap) and R (res. tap) from the table.
Repeat the Above Test for Phases B-C and C-A
Testing the Phase to Ground Measuring Elements
Repeat the Above Test for Phases B-N and C-N
Measuring the Operating Times
Repeat Tests for Zone 2 and Zone 3 Operating Times
Repeat Tests for Phase to Earth Operating Times
Voltage Level Detector
Low Set Current Test
Set the relay on option 06
High Set Current
Set the relay on Option 07
Inject the current for phase to neutral until
The pick up given by (7.5 x In) / (100 x Kzph)
Repeat the above for phases S-N and T-N
 When the relay picks up the monitor will read:
Biased Low Set Current Residual Level Detector
Biased High Set Residual Current Level Detector
Repeat the above for phases S-N and T-N.
Power Swing Blocking Test
Set the taps on the impedance unit of the ZFB tester to a value greater
 than zone 6 impedance.
Decrease the % potential switches S5 and S6 until the relay picks up and 1
 appears under the column on the monitor.
Measuring the Time Z6 (TZ6)
Simulated Power Swing Blocking
Re-select monitor option 08 which makes available information on all zones
 giving trip out puts after any set time delay
Voltage Transformer Supervision
Operation occurs when the zero sequence voltage above a set level is detected
without any zero sequence current being detected above a set level. If set
"TO ALLOW TRIP" instantaneous indication will be given if operation
conditions are satisfied and a comparator is operated.
Operation on Zero Sequence Volts
The operation time 5.5 second+0.1 seconds. The zero sequence voltage setting
is 15% of 635 v, thus the required voltage reduction on one phase is 45% of 63.5v
